arxiv-2012-07067.title: Supercongruences of multiple harmonic q q -sums and generalized finite/symmetric multiple zeta values
arxiv-2012-07067.creator: Yoshihiro Takeyama, Koji Tasaka
arxiv-2012-07067.description: Abstract . The Kaneko–Zagier conjecture describes a correspondence between finite multiple zeta values and symmetric multiple zeta values. Its refined version has been established by Jarossay, Rosen and Ono–Seki–Yamamoto. In this paper, we explicate these conjectures through studies of multiple harmonic q q -sums.

arxiv-2102-05319.title: Orbital order in a bosonic p p -band triangular lattice
arxiv-2102-05319.creator: Hua Chen, X. C. Xie
arxiv-2102-05319.description: Abstract We present a detailed study of the Bose-Hubbard model in a p p -band triangular lattice by focusing on the evolution of orbital order across the superfluid-Mott insulator transition. Two distinct phases are found in the superfluid regime. One of these phases adiabatically connects the weak interacting limit.

arxiv-2104-05182.title: Automated Mechanism Design for Classification with Partial Verification
arxiv-2104-05182.creator: Hanrui Zhang, Yu Cheng, Vincent Conitzer
arxiv-2104-05182.description: Abstract We study the problem of automated mechanism design with partial verification, where each type can (mis)report only a restricted set of types (rather than any other type), induced by the principal’s limited verification power. We prove hardness results when the revelation principle does not necessarily hold, as well as when types have even minimally different preferences.

We include the leading charge-symmetry breaking (CSB) interaction into our hyperon-nucleon interaction derived within chiral effective field theory at next-to-leading order.

arxiv-2402-06298.title: Mergeable weighted majority games and characterizations of some power indices
arxiv-2402-06298.creator: Livino M. Armijos-Toro, José M. Alonso-Meijide, Manuel A. Mosquera
arxiv-2402-06298.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Livino M. Armijos-Toro, José M. Alonso-Meijide, Manuel A. Mosquera. In this paper, we introduce a notion of mergeable weighted majority games with the aim of providing the first characterization of the Colomer-Martínez power index ( Colomer and Martínez 1995 ) . Furthermore, we define and characterize a new power index for the family of weighted majority games that combines ideas of the Public Good ( Holler 1982 ) and Colomer-Martínez power indices.

arxiv-2404-14732.title: A figure-of-merit-based framework to evaluate photovoltaic materials
arxiv-2404-14732.creator: Andrea Crovetto
arxiv-2404-14732.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andrea Crovetto. I propose a general quantitative framework to evaluate the quality, track the historical development, and guide future optimization of photovoltaic (PV) absorbers at any development level, including both experimentally synthesized and computer-simulated materials. The framework is based on a PV figure of merit designed to include efficiency limitations due to imperfect photocarrier collection that are not included in classic detailed balance methods.

arxiv-2410-02888.description: Abstract . Self-service machines are a form of pseudo-automation; rather than actually automate tasks, they offset them to unpaid customers. Typically implemented for customer convenience and to reduce labor costs, self-service is often criticized for worsening customer service and increasing loss and theft for retailers.

arxiv-2412-08800.title: A Hybrid Framework for Statistical Feature Selection and Image-Based Noise-Defect Detection
arxiv-2412-08800.creator: Alejandro Garnung Menéndez, M.Sc., PhD Candidate
arxiv-2412-08800.description: Abstract In industrial imaging, accurately detecting and distinguishing surface defects from noise is critical and challenging, particularly in complex environments with noisy data. This paper presents a hybrid framework that integrates both statistical feature selection and classification techniques to improve defect detection accuracy while minimizing false positives.
